name: launchproof
description: Turn a finished project into a public-ready GitHub repo for Claude Code and Codex: full-history hygiene scan (emails, home paths, secrets, private names), README with proof, comparison, limitations and FAQ, community health files, CI badge, release notes, llms.txt, AGENTS.md, a GitHub Pages page with JSON-LD and Open Graph, topics and social preview, scored by a checklist and fixed until it passes, plus a multi-channel launch plan with draft posts. Never publishes or posts on its own.
